desc:
🌑 Step into a realm where ancient bloodlines, forbidden magic, and primal instincts collide. Choose your path as a supernatural being — whether vampire, witch, werewolf, or something even darker — each with their own powers, strengths, and dark secrets.

🏰 Uncover hidden truths and forge your legacy across immersive locations like the haunted town of Covington.

🧛‍♀️ Embody a legendary character from myth and lore — or craft your own original identity, customizing every detail from appearance to backstory.

🕹️ Play anywhere, anytime — available on PC, mobile, and console.

💬 Join our growing community to share feedback, report issues, and be part of the journey as the legend evolves.
